data.narrative:
Clone Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Dhanush Radhakrishnan and Lucas Kozlik. The target has raised $7.1M to date. The broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector includes 9 peer companies (1 public, 8 private), including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI, though a sufficiently narrow peer set at identical stage and valuation tier does not exist for direct median benchmarking.

Given data constraints, Stage-Progression analysis is the primary applicable method. Using total raised ($7.1M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied value of $18M. This method assumes trajectory consistent with peer stage transitions in the sector.

The Peer-Median method is not applicable; while 10 same-sector peers exist, filtering by stage, adjacent-stage, and valuation tier returned fewer than the three datapoints required for reliable median estimation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise.

The triangulated valuation range is $15M (low) to $20M (high), with $18M as the central estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight-fit comparables at this stage and sector maturity, the reliance on a single applicable method, and inherent variance in stage-transition multiples across different robotics subsectors and market conditions.
